caption: The drawing features a single ornate key positioned horizontally and centrally on a plain, off-white background. The key is colored in shades of gold and brown, with intricate detailing on the bow (the handle) and the bit (the end that inserts into a lock), which appears decorative and stylized. To the right of the key, relatively small and in capital letters, is the text "HARRY GROSEN." The rest of the composition is empty, with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Watch Key
